info.title: Aarogyam API
info.description: The clinic platform's API. The clinic comes from the host name.

get.summary: Lists every clinic with member and patient counts.

404.description: Not the console host

post.summary: Creates a clinic and invites its owner. Owner and onboarding staff only.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

get.summary: Service health: API, database and edge.

post.summary: Signs in as a seeded person (local development only).
Finds medicines in the shared list.

Delivers due outbox messages across clinics (local development only; later Cloud
Scheduler with a Google-signed token).

Accepts an invitation. The person must have signed in with the email address it was sent
to; each invitation works once and expires after seven days.

404.description: Unknown, used or expired invitation

409.description: The invitation is for another email address

get.summary: Bills, newest first, without lines.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First clinic day, YYYY-MM-DD (issue date; start date for drafts)

400.description: A bad filter

post.summary: Starts a draft bill for a patient.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: Opens a bill with its lines. Writes the access record.

404.description: No such bill in this clinic

patch.summary: Edits a draft bill. Issued and void bills never change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such bill in this clinic

409.description: The bill is issued or void

post.summary:
Issues a draft: GST per line (CGST and SGST, or IGST across states), round-off to the
rupee, a number in the clinic's financial year, and the printed facts captured. Final.

400.description: The bill has no lines

404.description: No such bill in this clinic

post.summary: Voids a bill with a reason. It is kept with its number; bill again to correct it.

400.description: No reason given

404.description: No such bill in this clinic

409.description: Already void, or payments still count towards it

get.summary: The signed-in person's clinics, for the clinic switcher.
Where the signed-in person is signed in: their sessions that are neither revoked nor expired.

post.summary: Signs one of the person's own sessions out. Its next request gets `401`, on every host.

404.description: Not one of the person's sessions

get.summary: The most recently registered patients.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Registers a patient and issues the clinic's next number.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

post.summary:
Finds patients by number, phone or name. A POST so names and phone numbers stay out of
URLs, which proxies, browsers and logs keep.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary: Opens a patient's record. Every open is written to the access record.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

patch.summary:
Edits a patient's details with the same rules as registration. Changing the phone or email
also needs `patients.contact`. The change history records each change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

403.description: The role lacks patients.write, or patients.contact for phone or email

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: A patient's prescriptions, newest first.

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

post.summary: Starts a draft prescription for a patient.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such patient in this clinic

get.summary: The patient's last issued prescription, for Quick Rx (repeat it as a new draft).

404.description: No such patient, or no issued prescription yet

get.summary: Payments received, newest first.

400.description: A bad date

post.summary:
Records a payment against issued bills and issues a receipt number. Needs an
`Idempotency-Key` header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per payment; a retry sends the same key

400.description: Invalid input, a missing key, or an allocation past a bill's balance or the payment

404.description: No such patient or bill in this clinic

409.description: The key was used for a different payment, or a bill isn't issued

get.summary: One payment, for its receipt.

404.description: No such payment in this clinic

post.summary: Voids a payment with a reason. The bills it paid show their balance again.

400.description: No reason given

404.description: No such payment in this clinic

get.summary: Opens a prescription with its print data. Writes the access record.

404.description: No such prescription in this clinic

patch.summary: Edits a draft. Issued prescriptions never change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such prescription in this clinic

post.summary:
Cancels an issued prescription with a reason and, by default, starts a corrected draft
copied from it.

400.description: No reason given

404.description: No such prescription in this clinic

post.summary:
Issues a draft: allergy check, number, print data, frozen. With alerts and no
`override_reason`, answers `409` with the alerts and changes nothing.

400.description: No medicines, or a bad reason

404.description: No such prescription in this clinic

409.description: Allergy alerts need an override reason, or already issued

post.summary: Makes a seven-day link for the patient to open the prescription with a PIN.

404.description: No such prescription in this clinic

get.summary: The clinic's price list.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary: Adds a price list entry.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

patch.summary: Changes a price list entry. Issued bills keep what they printed.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the field

404.description: No such entry in this clinic

get.summary:
Collections by day, week and method, and the revenue mix. The last seven days by default;
at most 366 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First clinic day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: six days before to)

400.description: A bad or too long range

get.summary: Issued bills with a balance, oldest first, with aging buckets.
The clinic's roles and the permissions each holds, for choosing a role.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary:
The clinic, member and permissions for this host. The portal hides what the role can't
do; the API still enforces it.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary:
The clinic's settings: profile, GSTIN, time zone, branding, prescription footer, address,
phone and UPI ID.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

patch.summary: Changes the clinic's settings. The change history records each change.

400.description: Invalid input; the message names the setting

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

get.summary: Public, no sign-in: whether a link exists and which clinic sent it.

404.description: No such link

post.summary:
Public, no sign-in: opens the prescription with the PIN. Five wrong PINs lock the link.
Every open is written to the access record.

403.description: Wrong PIN; the message says how many tries are left

404.description: No such link

423.description: Locked after too many wrong PINs

get.summary: The clinic's members, with their roles, status and branches, and pending invitations.

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

post.summary:
Invites someone to the staff and emails them the link (through the outbox). Only owners
may invite owners.

400.description: Invalid email or unknown role

403.description: The role lacks staff.manage, or a non-owner invited an owner

404.description: Not a clinic, or not a member of it

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role or status. Takes effect on the member's next request. Nobody
changes their own role, only owners make or change owners, and the last active owner
can't be suspended, removed or demoted.

400.description: Unknown role or status

403.description: The role lacks staff.manage, or only an owner may do this

404.description: No such member in this clinic

409.description: Your own role, or the last active owner

get.summary:
Money for the Today screen: today's collections, pending dues, this month's revenue mix
and the largest unpaid balances.
Public, no sign-in: the QR code's check that a prescription is genuine.

parameters.name: verify_token
parameters.description: The token in the QR code

404.description: No such prescription

get.summary: Liveness check.
get.description: Answers `ok` while the process is serving; a database outage does not fail it.

display_name.description: The name to show colleagues, when signing in for the first time.

token.description: The secret from the invitation link.

Address.description: A postal address. Every part is optional.

AgingBuckets.description: Owed by age of the bill.

Allocation.description: Part of a payment going to a bill.

amount_paise.description: Paise; no more than the bill's balance.

invoice_id.description: The bill: issued, of the same patient.

reissue.description: Start a corrected draft copied from it (default true).

Cancelled.description: The cancelled prescription and its corrected draft.

oneOf.description: The new draft that supersedes it, when reissued.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; `Asia/Kolkata` is the only one supported.

upi_id.description: UPI ID shown on bills, such as `clinic@okicici`.

ClinicSettingsChanges.description:
Changes to the settings. Settings left out stay as they are; an empty string clears an
optional one. Branding changes only the keys given; a given address replaces the whole
address.

gstin.description: GSTIN, checked including its check character.

phone.description: The main branch's phone; +91 is assumed without a country code.

prescription_footer.description: Footer printed on prescriptions, up to 500 characters.

by_day.description: Every day, zero when nothing came in.

by_method.description: Every method, for the UPI share.

by_week.description: Weeks starting Monday, for the weekly collections chart.

invoiced_paise.description: Total of bills issued in the range.

outstanding_paise.description: Left to pay on every issued bill, now.

revenue_mix.description: Bills issued in the range by category, for the revenue mix.

CreatedClinic.description: A clinic just created. `invite_token` is shown once; only its hash is stored.

invite_token.description: The invitation secret, for the link sent to the owner.

CreatedInvitation.description: An invitation just sent. `invite_token` is shown once; only its hash is stored.

invite_token.description:
The secret for the invitation link (`https://<clinic host>/invite#<token>`), also
emailed to the invitee.

DayTotal.description: Money received on a day, or in a week starting that Monday.

auth_uid.description: The person's Supabase Auth id (`users.auth_uid`), from the local seed.

email.description: A verified email to put in the token, for accepting invitations.

email_provider.description: `resend`, or `log` when no Resend key is configured.

retrying.description: Failed, to be tried again later.

items.description: Names starting with the query first.

q.description: Part of a name or strength, such as `amox` or `500`.

Invoice.description: A bill. Amounts are paise; on drafts they are a preview computed from the current lines.

balance_paise.description: Left to pay on an issued bill.

methods.description: Methods of the payments towards it.

payment_state.description: For issued bills: `unpaid`, `partial` or `paid`, derived from payments.

place_of_supply.description: Place of supply state code, when set.

recipient.description: The patient as printed: name and number.

replaces_invoice_id.description: The voided bill this one replaces.

subtotal_paise.description: Sum of quantity times unit price.

supplier.description: The clinic as printed: name, legal name, GSTIN, state code, address, phone.

InvoiceEdit.description:
Changes to a draft. Fields left out stay; `items` replaces every line; an empty string
clears `encounter_id`, `place_of_supply` or `notes`.

InvoiceLineInput.description:
A line on a draft: from a price list entry, whose values fill whatever is left out, or
free text with a description and a unit price.

discount_paise.description: Discount on the whole line, in paise.

IssueBlocked.description: The alerts that stopped an issue.

alerts.description: Send again with `override_reason` to issue anyway.

override_reason.description: Why to go ahead despite the allergy alerts; needed only when there are alerts.

clinics.description: Clinics they are invited to or active in, by name.

branches.description: Branches they work at; empty means every branch.

MemberBranch.description: A branch a member works at.

MemberChanges.description: A change to a member. Fields left out stay as they are.

share_bps.description: Share of everything received, in basis points (10000 is all).

MixItem.description: Billed revenue in one price list category.

category.description: The category, or `other` for free-text lines.

share_bps.description: Share of all billed, in basis points.

MyClinic.description: A clinic the person belongs to.

role_key.description: The person's role there, such as `doctor`.

MySession.description: A device or browser where the person is signed in.

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

last_active_at.description: When it was last used, to within a few minutes (RFC 3339).

owner_email.description: The owner's email; they are invited as the clinic owner.

slug.description: The subdomain; derived from the name when absent.

email.description: Their email; they sign in with it to accept.

role_key.description: The role they will get, such as `doctor`.

place_of_supply.description: GST state code of the place of supply, when not the branch's state (IGST applies).

replaces_invoice_id.description: The voided bill this one replaces.

age_years.description: Age in years when the date of birth is unknown.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`); give this or `age_years`.

phone.description: Phone; +91 is assumed without a country code.

NewPayment.description:
A payment to record. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID per payment form); a retry
with the same key returns the first payment instead of recording another.

allocations.description: The bills it pays; what is left over stays as an advance.

pin.description: The six digits printed on the paper.

Patient.description: A patient. Phone and email are masked (`+91******3210`) unless the role has `patients.contact`.

birth_date_estimated.description: Whether the date of birth was estimated from an age.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), exact or estimated.

last_visit_at.description: The last visit (RFC 3339), once visits exist.

PatientChanges.description:
Changes to a patient. Fields left out stay as they are; an empty `phone`, `email` or
`date_of_birth` clears it.

age_years.description: Age in years when the date of birth is unknown.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), or empty to clear it; give this or `age_years`.

email.description: Email, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

phone.description: Phone, or empty to clear it; needs `patients.contact`.

PatientRef.description: A patient as a bill or payment names them.

Payment.description: A payment and its receipt number.

PendingItem.description: An issued bill with something left to pay.

outstanding_paise.description: Left to pay on all of them, in paise.

code.description: Short code, unique in the clinic.

sac_hsn.description: SAC (9993 for health care) or HSN code.

taxable.description: Whether GST applies. Health care by a clinical establishment is exempt.

PriceItemValues.description:
A price list entry's values. On a change, fields left out stay as they are and an empty
string clears an optional one.

category.description: Revenue-mix category: lower case, digits and `_`.

name.description: Name; required for a new entry.

price_paise.description: Default price in paise; required for a new entry.

taxable.description:
Whether GST applies (medicines and products); false (exempt) by default unless a rate
is given.

PrintData.description: What the paper shows besides the medicines.

brand_line.description: `Prescribed with Aarogyam`, printed beside the QR code.

doctor.description: Doctor's name and registration number (null when not recorded).

letterhead.description: Clinic name, legal name, address, phone, brand colour.

patient.description: Patient's name, number, age and sex at issue.

verify_path.description: Path the QR code opens on the clinic's host.

Reason.description: A reason, for voiding or cancelling.

is_template.description: Whether it is one of the standard roles.

items.description: Standard roles first, then by name.

drug_id.description: The catalogue entry; its values fill what is left out.

drug_name.description: As printed, generic name in capitals; required for free text.

RxValues.description:
A draft's values. On an edit, fields left out stay, an empty string clears text,
`encounter_id` or `follow_up_on`, and `items` replaces every medicine.

language.description: Language, such as `hi-IN`; the patient's by default.

SearchRequest.description: What to search for. Sent in the body, never the URL: search terms are names and phone numbers.

q.description:
A number (`SD-1042` or `1042`), a phone number, or the start of a name. Empty lists
the most recently registered patients.

ServiceMetrics.description: Service health for the console dashboard.

api.description: This instance's API requests, error rates and latency.

db.description: Database connections, cache hit ratio, size, tables and slow statements.

edge.description: Edge and front-end numbers from Cloudflare; `null` until connected.

SessionClinic.description: The clinic the portal runs in.

SessionMembership.description: The member's place in the clinic.

permissions.description: Permission keys the role holds, such as `patients.read`.

ShareLink.description: A new patient link. The token and PIN are shown once.

pin.description: Six-digit PIN to print on the paper or tell the patient.

token.description: Token for the link: `/shared/{token}` on the clinic's host.

SharedPreview.description: What a link shows before its PIN: no patient data.

invitations.description: Invitations neither accepted nor expired, newest first.

members.description: Members, active first, then by name.

collected_paise.description: Received today, in paise (the revenue tile).

pending.description: The five largest balances, for the pending payments table.

pending_dues_paise.description: Left to pay on every issued bill (the pending dues tile).

revenue_mix.description: This month's revenue mix, for the donut.

upi_share_bps.description: UPI's share of this month's collections, in basis points.

Verification.description: What the QR code shows: never patient data.

issued_on.description: The clinic day it was issued.
